page.title: Your assistant
page.desc: How it talks to you, what it explains about your status and how to use voice. It runs on this device, offline.
explica.title: Explain my status
explica.hint: Summarizes in plain words the status the system rules already computed. It does not diagnose or change the level.
explica.ia: Generated by local AI. Not a diagnosis; the level is computed by the system rules.
explica.reglas: Built from local rules, no generative AI. Not a diagnosis.
explica.error: Could not get the explanation right now.
voz.title: Talk to the assistant
voz.hint: Tap the floating bubble at the bottom right, ask your question and tap again to send it. Audio is processed on this device and is not stored.
voz.nota: Needs local voice enabled on the device and a microphone (from localhost or over HTTPS).
prefs.title: Your assistant
prefs.hint: Choose how you want it to talk to you. Only what you choose is saved.
prefs.saved: Saved. Recommendations will use this style.
